title: Watch Daft Punk’s Thomas Bangalter give a rare helmet-off interview.
summary: After joining Fred Again for an absolutely incredible DJ set at USB002 earlier this year, Bangalter is making another helmet-free appearance this year, sitting down with Devonté Hynes (aka Blood Orange) for an interview on the A24 podcast.
